verdict.rationale: There is no documented export feature, but leaving is plausible. Trigger.dev is open source and self-hostable, tasks are plain TypeScript kept in your own codebase, and the management SDK can list runs programmatically, so you can pull run data out yourself and move to your own infrastructure. Missing for 10: a documented bulk export of all account data (runs, payloads, outputs, logs, schedules) in open formats, a documented migration path off Cloud, and independent corroboration of a successful exit.
